hash_semantics.local_revision: Historical delta from published_baseline, now published on main in commit e5829d1ca8933b9b4cfe7aa1670a5440aafb5596. In files, published_sha256 is the earlier baseline hash (null for additions) and local_sha256 is the released revision hash (null for removals). The key name preserves the original staging history. This manifest excludes its own digest to avoid self-reference.
